newsitem.title: ESTONIA: PLAZA HOTEL CONSTRUCTION TO START THIS YEAR.
newsitem.headline: PLAZA HOTEL CONSTRUCTION TO START THIS YEAR.

text.p: Plaza Hotel Ltd, the joint stock company of Estonia's Sakala center and Britain's Roche & Co, will begin construction of a five-star hotel in the centre of Tallinn this year, newspaper Eesti Paevaleht said on Thursday.
Close to $50 million in investments will be sunk into the 250-room hotel, to be named the Holiday Inn Crowne Plaza, Plaza Hotel chairman David Roche was quoted as saying.
The construction of the hotel will be supported by the World Bank's International Financial Corporation, the newspaper added.
